name: Knights — Legion Commander / Chaos Knight
description: The stable 6 Troll / 4 Knight board, with a raid-boss Legion Commander that permanently scales attack damage every home battle she survives. 2 Wizards unlock the 6th troll and 4th knight tiers. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'HOW TO PLAY Legion Commander/CK Knights Build In Auto Chess'.

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: 5 trolls + 2 wizards = 6-Troll attack-speed stacking; 4 knights (Batrider bridges troll and knight) give team shields. Dazzle's Shadow Grave keeps three-star carries alive; Legion Commander blinks the backline while Chaos Knight and Luna grind the front.
